item.title: Tired of Out-of-Sync Subtitles? ffsubsync vs alass vs libass in 2026
item.description: Twenty minutes into a film, the dialogue drifts four seconds ahead of the picture. You nudge the offset in your player, and it holds — until the ad break in the source cut, where it snaps out of alignment again. Across a library of a few hundred files, roughly one in five subtitles has this problem, and fixing them by hand is a genuinely terrible use of an evening.
